description: Image Description: The image shows two elephants, one larger and one smaller, standing on sandy ground in front of a wire fence. Behind the fence, there is sparse vegetation consisting of bushes and small trees. The sky above is mostly cloudy with patches of blue visible. The scene appears to be in a dry, open area resembling a savanna or desert environment. The elephants are positioned side by side, facing towards the right of the image. In the background, distant hills or mountains can be seen.
